name: Vendor-Specific Range
description: Validates that a numeric field falls within a vendor-specific range (Siemens / GE / Philips). Declare Manufacturer plus the field to check; configure per-vendor bounds (leave blank to skip a vendor) and whether a violation is an error or a warning.

testCases.name: Vendor without configured bounds is not checked
Same TE fails when the range is tightened
Out-of-range only warns with warning severity

parameterDefinitions.name: label
parameterDefinitions.label: Value label
parameterDefinitions.description: Human-readable name of the checked value, used in messages (e.g. 'MPRAGE TE')

parameterDefinitions.name: severity
parameterDefinitions.label: Severity
parameterDefinitions.description: Whether an out-of-range value fails validation or only warns
